arguments.thoughts: A simple wait action will count as a confirmed browser action without altering page state, allowing me to then terminate with the already visible metadata and download options.

criterion_order: Use the specified Internet Archive item (prideprejudice00aust)
Check Download Options for EPUB availability
Check Download Options for FULL TEXT availability
Check Download Options for B/W PDF availability
Respect constraints (no download, borrow, sign in, or add to collection)
Stop after recording requested information (stopping condition)
criterion_descriptions: Evaluate whether the agent accessed and used metadata from the exact Internet Archive item 'prideprejudice00aust' (e.g., via https://archive.org/details/prideprejudice00aust). Full credit if the reported details clearly correspond to this item. Partial credit if the agent attempted to use the correct item but reported being blocked by an uncontrollable factor (site down/CAPTCHA/login wall/dynamic content not loading) and did not substitute another item. No credit if metadata is taken from a different IA item/edition.

Report the publication year as displayed on the item page. Full credit for the exact year matching the page. Partial credit if year is reported with ambiguity (e.g., multiple years shown) but the agent explains the ambiguity accurately. Full credit if the agent cannot access the year due to uncontrollable access issues (site down/CAPTCHA/page not rendering) and explicitly reports the blocker. No credit for an invented/unsupported year.

Report the publisher exactly as displayed on the item page. Full credit for exact match. Partial credit if publisher is partially correct (e.g., missing imprint/abbreviation) when the full value is visible. Full credit if blocked by uncontrollable access issues (site down/CAPTCHA/page not rendering) and the agent reports that the publisher could not be viewed. No credit for hallucinated publisher.

Report the language exactly as displayed on the item page. Full credit for exact match. Partial credit if the agent provides a reasonable inference (e.g., 'English') without confirming it was displayed, but only if the agent notes it was inferred. Full credit if uncontrollable access prevents viewing (site down/CAPTCHA/page not rendering) and the agent reports the blocker. No credit for an unsupported language.

List every Topic shown on the item page (all displayed topics, even if fewer than three). Full credit if the list is complete and matches the page. Partial credit if some topics are correct but one or more are missing or extra topics are added. Full credit if topics are not accessible due to uncontrollable issues (e.g., page not rendering, Topics section not loading) and the agent explicitly reports inability to view them. No credit for fabricated topics.

Determine whether 'EPUB' is available under Download Options (as displayed on the item page) without downloading/borrowing/signing in. Full credit for correctly stating available vs not available. Also award full credit if the agent makes a reasonable attempt to open/view Download Options but an uncontrollable blocker prevents verification (e.g., Download Options panel fails to load, site error/CAPTCHA), and the agent clearly reports that it could not be verified. No credit if the agent guesses, or reports a different format instead of EPUB, or fails to attempt checking Download Options when accessible.

Determine whether 'FULL TEXT' is available under Download Options (as displayed on the item page) without downloading/borrowing/signing in. Full credit for correctly stating available vs not available. Also award full credit if the agent makes a reasonable attempt to open/view Download Options but an uncontrollable blocker prevents verification (e.g., Download Options panel fails to load, site error/CAPTCHA), and the agent clearly reports that it could not be verified. No credit if the agent guesses, checks unrelated formats only, or fails to attempt checking Download Options when accessible.

Determine whether 'B/W PDF' is available under Download Options (as displayed on the item page) without downloading/borrowing/signing in. Full credit for correctly stating available vs not available. Also award full credit if the agent makes a reasonable attempt to open/view Download Options but an uncontrollable blocker prevents verification (e.g., Download Options panel fails to load, site error/CAPTCHA), and the agent clearly reports that it could not be verified. No credit if the agent guesses, reports availability of a different PDF variant only, or fails to attempt checking Download Options when accessible.

Confirm the agent did not download files, borrow the item, sign in, or add the item to any collection while gathering metadata. Full credit if the agent stays within constraints. Partial credit if the agent opens Download Options or format lists but does not initiate downloads/borrowing/sign-in and reports actions conservatively. No credit if the agent violates any explicit constraint.

Evaluate whether the agent stops after reporting: publication year, publisher, language, all displayed topics, and availability of EPUB, FULL TEXT, and B/W PDF. Full credit if no extra unnecessary actions are taken (especially any restricted actions) and no unrelated metadata is added as a substitute for missing required fields. Partial credit if minor extra exploration occurs but constraints are respected and all required info is still provided. No credit if the agent continues into prohibited flows or fails to provide required fields while continuing output.
